asked.item: Can all four pictures go out on Threads in one post
Or must they pick one picture
Why the error occurred with the copied Instagram request

verdict.reason: The pages say Threads takes 1 image or video per post and that multiple images go out as a thread with one image per post via additionalPosts.

steps.text: Blotato's Threads publisher accepts 1 image or video per post, so a mediaUrls array with more than one item fails with the error "Threads only supports a single image or a video".
You don't have to pick one: publish a thread instead, with one image per post.
Put each extra post in the additionalPosts array with a single item in its mediaUrls: post 1 contains image 1, post 2 contains image 2, and so on.
